content.title: Visit Villanova | Villanova University
content.text: We're thrilled you're considering visiting our campus! We've compiled a list of transportation options, local attractions, accommodations and restaurants to help those planning to come to Villanova. TRANSPORTATION Villanova University is 12 miles west of Center City Philadelphia in the heart of the historic Main Line. Located near the intersection of two major interstate highways, I-76 and I-476, Villanova's campus is easily accessible by car, commuter train, trolley or bus. Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) is located 20 miles from campus. LOCAL ATTRACTIONS Many businesses are within walking and driving distance to Villanova's campus. Places like Lancaster Avenue, Suburban Square in Ardmore, and the Villanova Center adjacent to campus offer countless options for sipping coffee, grabbing ice cream, shopping and more. Please see below for a few suggestions and check out visitdelcopa.com for more ideas. ACCOMMODATIONS As you plan your visit to Villanova, you may need to reserve a hotel room or two. There are plenty of options in the area. Stay awhile!* RESTAURANTS There are plenty of restaurant options close to Villanova that cater to all types of palates, price points and atmospheres.* *These lists are curated by Student Life staff based on recommendations from students and families. For an extensive listing of establishments near Villanova University, we encourage you to visit opentable.com, resy.com and local business associations.
